⏺ Gate green. Running e2e/all.sh now.

  Created PR #323, ran 1 shell command

⏺ I've opened PR #323. Relays into Claude Code's new input box are now checked properly again: a paste that sits unsent there now fails
  loudly instead of reporting "sent". The unit tests, the full e2e/all.sh run (including the hostile-conf runs), go build/vet/test and
  gofmt all pass.

  - The fix: the box finder in internal/tmux/ovs.go now recognises the new box shape: the bottom pair of full-width ─ lines near the
    end of the pane, where the first line inside starts with ❯. It tries this shape before the old │/╰ one, which still works for older
    Claude Code. Text sitting in the box no longer counts as delivered.
  - Popups are safe: question pickers and permission prompts use the same full-width ─ lines. Their first line doesn't start with ❯, so
    they're not mistaken for the input box and relays to them still count as delivered.
  - Fixtures: I captured real screens from Claude Code 2.1.283 in an isolated tmux server (idle box, unsent text, a [Pasted text #1 +6
    lines] chip, a running turn, a submitted prompt). I also added two 2.1.282 popup captures from the chat-ux branch. The new tests
    check the cases you listed: unsent text and a pasted-text chip read as not delivered, an idle box as delivered, and text still in
    the box is not counted as picked up.
  - e2e/relay.sh: the fake claude now also draws the new box, in a third test leg. With the old code in place that leg fails (✓ sent to
    task-003); with the fix it passes.
  - Docs: added a dated LEARNINGS.md entry, a TASKS.md row, and a new "TUI chrome" section in the claude-code-facts skill. That skill
    had no section on how the Claude Code screen is drawn, so I created one.

  Two things I found while capturing:
  - The idle box isn't empty in a plain capture. It shows a greyed-out suggestion (Try "refactor main.go") that looks like typed text.
    It does no harm here, because the check looks for the relayed text itself rather than an empty box.
  - esc to interrupt didn't show during a running turn on 2.1.283. That text is one of the two signals the grove-186 warning uses to
    see that a message was picked up. The other signal, the sent text appearing above the box, still works, so the warning holds up for
    now. It's worth its own ticket before that signal becomes the only one.

  STATUS: DONE — Relay verification now recognises Claude Code 2.1.282+'s input box (full-width ─ lines, first line ❯), so text left
  unsent in it fails loudly instead of reporting "sent", and text still in the box no longer counts as picked up. The old box shape is
  still supported, question and permission popups still read as delivered, and "no box found counts as delivered" remains only for
  unknown layouts. Checked with real 2.1.283 captures in internal/tmux/testdata/ plus unit tests, and a new e2e/relay.sh leg drawing
  the new box that fails on the old code and passes with the fix. go build/vet/test and gofmt are clean, and e2e/all.sh passes.
  LEARNINGS, TASKS and the claude-code-facts skill are updated; PR #323 closes #317 and the issue is relabelled in-review.
